description: This Java source file defines the class HttpContextTenantAndAuthIdProvider, which provides methods to determine tenant and authentication ID information from HTTP request contexts, including handling SSL client certificates and authorization headers.

classes.name: HttpContextTenantAndAuthIdProvider
classes.description: Provides methods to extract tenant and auth ID information from HTTP contexts, including SSL client certificates and authorization headers.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves tenant and auth ID information from the given HttpContext, handling both authenticated and unauthenticated requests.

methods.name: getFromClientCertificate
methods.description: Extracts tenant and auth ID from SSL client certificate in the routing context.

methods.name: getFromAuthHeader
methods.description: Extracts tenant and auth ID from the Authorization header in the routing context.
